tools.name: list_image_assets
tools.description: List photos already uploaded to the connected account. Use an ID from this list to generate a video.

tools.name: quote_generation
tools.description: Check the credit cost and settings for turning an uploaded photo into a video. Does not start generation.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Animate one uploaded photo. This spends credits. Get a quote first and confirm cost and visibility with the user. Retry with the same request_id and inputs.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Check a task belonging to the connected account and get its video link when ready.
